_readme: What's New and Coming Soon, as the reader sees them.
Read by dge/js/modals.js each time the panel is opened, with no caching — so
publishing an update is an edit to this file, not a code change, and a visitor
who already has the site open sees it the next time they look.
enabled       false hides the panel entirely.
updates[]     { date: "YYYY-MM-DD", title, description }. Sorted newest
first by the reader; the order here does not matter.
comingSoon[]  { title, description }. Shown in the order given, since a
roadmap has no dates to sort by.
Keep descriptions to a sentence or two — this is a panel, not a changelog.

updates.title: Ramayana, Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana added
updates.description: Valmiki Ramayana (7 kandas), Mahabharata (18 parvas), Srimad Bhagavata Purana (12 skandhas) — all now live, native Devanagari.

updates.title: 4 smritis + 4 kavyas added
updates.description: Manu, Parashara, Yajnavalkya, Narada Smriti; Raghuvamsha, Kumarasambhava, Kiratarjuniya, Shishupalavadha.

updates.title: Guru Parampara launched
updates.description: 210 figures across 19 Madhva/Dvaita lineages — 2D tree, 3D showcase, data-completeness tracker. Find it under the 🧭 Explore menu.

updates.title: Tirtha Prabandha launched
updates.description: 95 holy places from Sri Vadiraja Tirtha's pilgrimage compendium, searchable and verse-referenced.

updates.title: Ashtadhyayi launched
updates.description: Panini's 3,962 sutras with 4 commentary layers (Kashika, Nyasa, Balamanorama, Tattvabodhini) and a BYOK AI tutor.

updates.title: Kosha (dictionary lookup) launched
updates.description: Multilingual Sanskrit dictionary search — floating कोश button, sample of 10 dictionaries live.

comingSoon.title: Harivamsha
comingSoon.description: Blocked on a GRETIL page-format fix — its source page structure doesn't match the current parser yet.

comingSoon.title: Full Kosha dataset
comingSoon.description: Growing from the current ~63 MB sample toward the full ~436 MB / 503,000-headword set.

comingSoon.title: Missing Ashtadhyayi commentary layers
comingSoon.description: Siddhanta-Kaumudi, Mahabhashya (Patanjali), and Vasu's English translation — UI slots are already there, waiting on the content.

comingSoon.title: Pada-cheda and anvaya for Ashtadhyayi
comingSoon.description: Word-splitting and prose-order display for each sutra.

comingSoon.title: Images for holy places
comingSoon.description: Brindavana photos (Guru Parampara) and tirtha-kshetra photos (Tirtha Prabandha).

comingSoon.title: Dasa Parampara lineage
comingSoon.description: A 20th lineage to add alongside the 19 already tracked in Guru Parampara.

comingSoon.title: Nearest holy place finder
comingSoon.description: Location-based lookup across both Tirtha Prabandha and Guru Parampara brindavanas.

comingSoon.title: Global corpus search
comingSoon.description: Sandhi/spelling-tolerant search across everything in the library, re-indexed to include recent additions.
